metaTitle: BMW Engine Breakdown Recovery & Nationwide Collection | BMW Garage
metaDescription: Professional BMW engine recovery service across the UK. We collect your BMW from any location and bring it to our specialist workshop for assessment and repair.
h1: BMW Engine Breakdown Recovery & Nationwide Collection
lede: We arrange same-day collection of your BMW from anywhere in the UK and transport it directly to our specialist workshop for a full assessment.

sections.heading: What Our BMW Engine Recovery Service Includes

blocks.html: When your BMW breaks down, the first step is to get it safely to a workshop that understands the brand. We provide a complete recovery and collection service for BMW vehicles across the UK, handling everything from the initial call to workshop intake.

items: Initial contact and incident assessment — we collect all relevant details about your vehicle and its location
Same-day dispatch of a recovery vehicle to your location, subject to availability
Safe loading and securing of your BMW on a flatbed recovery truck
Direct transport to our specialist [engine workshop](/bmw-engine-rebuild) in Billericay, Essex
Full workshop intake and logging into our system for assessment

blocks.html: We recover BMWs of all models and ages, from classic [3 Series](/bmw-3-series-engines) to modern [X5](/bmw-x5-engines) and high-performance [M3](/bmw-m3-engines) and [M5](/bmw-m5-engines) variants. Our [nationwide recovery](/bmw-engine-recovery) service means we can collect your vehicle from any location in the UK.

For specific quotes on collection from remote areas, out-of-hours recovery, or low-clearance BMW models (including M-badged variants), please [contact us directly](/contact) or use our [online quote form](/get-quote).
Our recovery service covers the full BMW range. We have specialist knowledge of low-clearance and performance models, and we take extra care with modern electronics and transmission systems.

We also cover [7 Series](/bmw-7-series-engines), [X6](/bmw-x6-engines), [X7](/bmw-x7-engines), [Z4](/bmw-z4-engines) and other BMW models — if you own it, we can recover it. For specific chassis codes and variant details, see our [BMW garage homepage](/) or [contact us](/contact).

sections.heading: Our Recovery Process — Step by Step

steps.title: Call or Request Online
steps.body: You contact us with your BMW's location and a description of the issue.

steps.title: Vehicle Assessment & Planning
steps.body: We check your model and confirm the safest recovery method. Low-clearance BMWs (e.g. M models) get specialist handling.

steps.title: Recovery Dispatch
steps.body: We dispatch a suitable recovery vehicle to your location — typically same-day.

steps.title: Safe Loading & Securing
steps.body: Your BMW is loaded onto a flatbed or trailer and secured with straps to prevent movement during transport.

steps.title: Transport to Workshop
steps.body: Your vehicle is transported directly to our workshop in Billericay, Essex.

steps.title: Workshop Intake
steps.body: On arrival, your BMW is logged into our system and queued for inspection and diagnosis.

sections.heading: How the Recovery Booking Process Works

steps.body: **Contact us** — by phone, WhatsApp, or our online form
**Vehicle details** — we confirm your BMW model, location, and any specific handling requirements
**Recovery dispatch** — we arrange a recovery vehicle to your location, typically same-day
**Transport & intake** — your BMW arrives at our workshop and is logged for assessment

blocks.html: Once your BMW is in our workshop, we can carry out a full range of engine and vehicle services.

items.q: How quickly can you recover my BMW?
items.a: We aim to dispatch a recovery vehicle on the same day you contact us, subject to availability and your location. We will provide an estimated arrival time when we confirm the booking.

items.q: Do you recover BMWs from anywhere in the UK?
items.a: Yes, we offer nationwide recovery and collection for BMW vehicles. We have transported cars from as far as Scotland and Cornwall to our workshop in Billericay, Essex.

items.q: Do you handle low-clearance BMWs like M cars?
items.a: Yes. We have specialist recovery equipment and procedures for low-clearance and performance BMWs (including M2, M3, M4, M5, M8, and M-badged SUVs) to avoid underbody damage.

items.q: What happens to my BMW when it arrives at the workshop?
items.a: On arrival, your BMW is logged into our workshop system and queued for inspection. We then carry out a full assessment of the engine and vehicle to determine the next steps, including if a [rebuild](/bmw-engine-rebuild) or [replacement](/bmw-engine-replacement) is needed.

items.q: Is recovery included if I book an engine rebuild?
items.a: Recovery is offered as a separate service, with prices starting from £70. We can provide a combined quote for recovery and workshop work. Please [contact us](/contact) for a complete estimate.
